findings.confirmed: No demonstration HDF5 or source metadata in allowlist; raw.read text-only; no demo tool
findings.effect: Cannot inspect state/action, RGB/tactile demonstration trajectories or verify candidate demonstration eligibility

findings.confirmed: Whitelist uses seed/trajectory.jsonl, evaluator records seed/attempt-N/trajectory.jsonl; real acceptance trajectory read denied
findings.effect: Subsequent diagnosis can see episode outcomes and video, but raw action trajectory is inaccessible

findings.confirmed: Verifier checks cited values and facts, not source coverage or reading trace; summary-only citation probe passes
findings.effect: Passing verification does not establish analysis of demonstrations, training process or representative feedback

findings.confirmed: th.curve points contain step/loss/source/line only, where loss is validation; ACT returns zero points and best only
findings.effect: Training loss, LR, gradient norm and temporal train-validation comparison require raw paging; ACT full curve not supplied

findings.confirmed: Only baseline/current training dirs and selected round feedback dirs enumerated; candidates omitted; tools target current round or round number, not candidate artifact
findings.effect: Cannot revisit all candidate failures or all intermediate training logs through the tools

findings.confirmed: No search, tail, semantic index or line-count/continuation metadata in raw.read; max 200 lines and 24000 chars per call, 40-tool limit
findings.effect: Large logs require selective navigation; DP full log would require at least 490 calls, promoting summary-only inspection

findings.confirmed: Only first recorded video and fixed start/mid/end frames; no timestamp or camera choice; visual evidence not structurally verifiable by citation schema
findings.effect: May miss contact/slip transition; viewing RGB frames does not establish analysis of tactile demonstration sequences

findings.confirmed: v2 requires rollout and training-curve inspection but not a distinct mandatory demonstration-versus-rollout comparison; frozen legacy inputs remain v1
findings.effect: Prompt edit alone cannot open inaccessible data or change existing experiment inputs

findings.confirmed: raw_files enumerates training-output text and feedback records, not training/evaluation/data-loader source; action space changes only checkpoint/LR/updates/demo IDs
findings.effect: Model cannot independently inspect preprocessing, normalization or action/state alignment code; structural pipeline defects may remain outside diagnosis and permitted remedies
findings.recommendation: If pipeline-level diagnosis is in scope, expose relevant vendored code as common read-only raw sources with provenance; do not silently expand executable action permissions

findings.confirmed: Feedback seeds 20001-20030 allowed; held-out test 20031-20060 excluded by design
findings.effect: Keep held-out test inaccessible; explicitly name feedback as diagnostic evaluation instead of broadly saying no test data

repair_order: Expose current-group demonstrations and metadata via a common raw interface with bounded HDF5 slicing and image decoding; keep raw/harness source access equal
Resolve feedback source paths from result records, enumerate all candidates and historical train dirs
Add aligned training metrics and searchable raw records with offsets/source references
Add structured inspection coverage for demos/training/feedback including unavailable reasons; cross-check receipts without claiming to prove reasoning quality
Require demonstration-versus-rollout comparison in a new versioned prompt; preserve old experimental inputs
limitations: Read events and valid citations cannot prove the quality of the model reasoning.
The current DP/pi05 v2 calls did inspect training metrics and representative feedback trajectories; the demonstrated complete block concerns training demonstrations and later-round raw trajectories.
No original source, training configuration, frozen prompt, gate or evaluation result was modified by this audit.
